A little less busywork.

AllToolForest brings useful everyday workflows into four focused spaces: Work, Documents, Images and Calculators.

Simple by design

Open a tool, bring your file or information, and leave with a useful result. No account is required. The tools work on your device, with practical limits explained where they matter.

Honest about what a tool can do

PDF overlays change appearance; they do not securely redact text. Resume matching compares words; it does not predict hiring decisions. Image enlargement uses resampling; it does not reconstruct missing detail. Calculators show estimates under stated assumptions.

Built around your tasks

We review suggestions for usefulness, demand, privacy, feasibility and fit with existing workflows.
